note: Synthetic. A targeted time table, a revaluation notice with a deadline, and a notice whose audience is stated but unreadable.

items.title: Time Table for B.E. V Semester Examination Dec.2026/Jan.2027
items.body: The theory examination time table for the fifth semester of the 2022 scheme is notified herewith. Candidates shall report thirty minutes before the commencement of each paper.

items.title: Notification - Application for revaluation and photocopy of answer scripts
items.body: Candidates who appeared for the June/July 2026 examination may apply for revaluation. Last date for submission of applications is 20 September 2026.

items.title: Circular - Examination centre change for the candidates concerned
items.body: The examination centre stands changed for the candidates concerned. The colleges are requested to inform the candidates individually.
